body:
Ardian has raised €1 billion for Ardian Semiconductor, which the Paris-based investment firm describes as one of the first private equity strategies dedicated to the semiconductor value chain [[1]](https://www.ardian.com/news-insights/press-releases/ardian-raises-eur1-billion-one-first-private-equity-platforms). The total is about $1.12 billion, Reuters reported [[2]](https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/french-ardian-raises-over-1-billion-invest-semiconductor/). Close to €700 million is fund commitments, and the rest comes from co-investments; Ardian did not say how much co-investment capital it raised [[1]](https://www.ardian.com/news-insights/press-releases/ardian-raises-eur1-billion-one-first-private-equity-platforms).

Investors from the Middle East and North Africa supplied 41% of the capital and French investors 24% [[1]](https://www.ardian.com/news-insights/press-releases/ardian-raises-eur1-billion-one-first-private-equity-platforms). The backers include government agencies, sovereign wealth funds, semiconductor companies, insurers and private wealth clients, though Ardian named none of them. New investors to Ardian accounted for 58% of commitments [[1]](https://www.ardian.com/news-insights/press-releases/ardian-raises-eur1-billion-one-first-private-equity-platforms).

The platform was formed through an exclusive partnership with Silian Partners, a group of former senior semiconductor executives who work with Ardian as one team. It invests mainly in European chip companies and also has a pipeline in North America and Asia [[1]](https://www.ardian.com/news-insights/press-releases/ardian-raises-eur1-billion-one-first-private-equity-platforms). Ardian is targeting specialty chips such as power, analog and photonics, plus IP, equipment, materials and consumables, and pointed to Semiconductor Industry Association data showing global chip sales passed $1 trillion in the first eight months of 2026 [[1]](https://www.ardian.com/news-insights/press-releases/ardian-raises-eur1-billion-one-first-private-equity-platforms).

Its four holdings are VSORA, a French fabless designer of AI inference accelerators for data centers; centrotherm, a German maker of thermal processing equipment used for silicon carbide power devices; Synergie CAD, a French test-interface company; and Ion Beam Services, a French ion implantation equipment and services firm [[1]](https://www.ardian.com/news-insights/press-releases/ardian-raises-eur1-billion-one-first-private-equity-platforms).

"Semiconductors are a highly specialized market where expertise is critical to identifying the strongest opportunities," said Lise Fauconnier, co-head of Ardian Semiconductor [[1]](https://www.ardian.com/news-insights/press-releases/ardian-raises-eur1-billion-one-first-private-equity-platforms). The fund has also been selected under France's Tibi initiative and is a member of the Ministry of Armed Forces' Defense Investor Club [[1]](https://www.ardian.com/news-insights/press-releases/ardian-raises-eur1-billion-one-first-private-equity-platforms).

p: Ardian은 Ardian Semiconductor를 위해 10억 유로를 모금했다. Ardian Semiconductor는 이를 반도체 가치 사슬에 전념하는 최초의 사모펀드 전략 중 하나로 설명합니다[[1]](https://www.ardian.com/news-insights/press-releases/ardian-raises-eur1-billion-one-first-private-equity-platforms). 총액은 약 11억 2천만 달러라고 Reuters는 보고했습니다[[2]](https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/french-ardian-raises-over-1-billion-invest-semiconductor/). 7억 유로에 가까운 자금 투입이 이루어지고 나머지는 공동 투자에서 나옵니다. Ardian은 얼마나 많은 공동 투자 자본을 조달했는지 밝히지 않았습니다[[1]](https://www.ardian.com/news-insights/press-releases/ardian-raises-eur1-billion-one-first-private-equity-platforms).

중동 및 북아프리카 투자자들이 자본금의 41%를, 프랑스 투자자들이 24%를 공급했습니다[[1]](https://www.ardian.com/news-insights/press-releases/ardian-raises-eur1-billion-one-first-private-equity-platforms). 후원자에는 정부 기관, 국부 펀드, 반도체 회사, 보험사 및 개인 자산 고객이 포함되지만 Ardian은 이들 중 누구도 언급하지 않았다. Ardian의 신규 투자자는 약속의 58%를 차지했습니다[[1]](https://www.ardian.com/news-insights/press-releases/ardian-raises-eur1-billion-one-first-private-equity-platforms).

이 플랫폼은 Ardian과 하나의 팀으로 일하는 전직 반도체 고위 임원 그룹인 Silian Partners와의 독점 파트너십을 통해 형성되었다. 주로 유럽 칩 회사에 투자하고 있으며 북미와 아시아에도 파이프라인을 보유하고 있습니다[[1]](https://www.ardian.com/news-insights/press-releases/ardian-raises-eur1-billion-one-first-private-equity-platforms). Ardian은 전력, 아날로그, 포토닉스, IP, 장비, 재료 및 소모품과 같은 특수 칩을 목표로 하고 있으며, 2026년 첫 8개월 동안 전 세계 칩 매출이 1조 달러를 돌파했다는 반도체 산업 협회 데이터를 지적했습니다[[1]](https://www.ardian.com/news-insights/press-releases/ardian-raises-eur1-billion-one-first-private-equity-platforms).

4개 보유 기업은 프랑스의 데이터 센터용 AI 추론 가속기 팹리스 설계업체인 VSORA이다. 실리콘 카바이드 전력 장치에 사용되는 열처리 장비를 생산하는 독일 제조업체인 centrotherm; 프랑스 테스트 인터페이스 회사인 Synergie CAD; 및 프랑스 이온 주입 장비 및 서비스 회사인 Ion Beam Services[[1]](https://www.ardian.com/news-insights/press-releases/ardian-raises-eur1-billion-one-first-private-equity-platforms).

Ardian Semiconductor[[1]](https://www.ardian.com/news-insights/press-releases/ardian-raises-eur1-billion-one-first-private-equity-platforms)의 공동 대표인 Lise Fauconnier는 "반도체는 가장 강력한 기회를 식별하는 데 전문성이 중요한 고도로 전문화된 시장이다."라고 말했다. 이 펀드는 프랑스의 Tibi 이니셔티브에 따라 선정되었으며 국방부 국방 투자자 클럽[[1]](https://www.ardian.com/news-insights/press-releases/ardian-raises-eur1-billion-one-first-private-equity-platforms)의 회원이기도 한다.
중요한 이야기를 하나의 이메일로 만나보세요. 무료 — 언제든지 구독을 취소할 수 있다.
